Commentary.Commentary: John  Campbell comes into the attack.

India were frustrated in the first half as they were unable to pick up wickets. Now they will look to build up a good lead and bat Windies out of the game. Windies, on the other hand, will look to pick up early wickets and reduce the deficit. Be back in a while for the third innings.

Many Windies batsmen got starts but threw their wickets away at crucial moments. Ishant Sharma was the star for India as he picked a five-fer. Chase was the only batsman who looked like sticking it out  and it is not a good looking scorecard for them.

West Indies have been bowled out for 222 and they trail by 75. West Indies have added 33 runs today and credit goes to Holder for sticking it out and playing a handy innings of 39 runs. Cummins played out 45 balls without scoring a run before Shami got the big wicket of Holder. Jadeja then got the last wicket of Cummins.

OUT! BOWLED! The Windies have been bowled out for 222 and trail India by 75 runs going into the third innings. Cummins is the last man to be dismissed after he faced 45 balls without scoring a single run! Jadeja comes around the wicket and bowls this one flatter and on the off pole, it spins back in just towards Cummins. He goes to slog sweep it but misses the ball altogether and it crashes into the off pole. The stumps are shattered and after a frustrating opening hour for the visitors, they have taken both the wickets quickly after Drinks.
Jadeja around the wicket, bowls this one flatter and on middle and leg, it hits the inside half of Gabriel's bat and the ball rolls towards fine leg for a single.
PLAY AND A MISS! On a good length outside off, Cummins attempts to defend but fails to put ball on it.
Full delivery on middle, Gabriel flicks it to mid-wicket and takes a single.
BEATEN! It is a good length ball outside off, Gabriel looks to drive but misses the ball completely.
Good length delivery on off, Gabriel plays it to mid off.

NOT OUT! BIG SHOUT FOR LBW! Shami bowls a full delivery on the leg stump, Gabriel goes for a flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. Shami goes for a huge appeal but the umpire is unmoved. Shami and co. go for a review but it looks desperate. The replays roll in and the Ball Tracker shows that the impact was outside leg stump. Poor review from India and they have lost their first review.
REVIEW TIME AGAIN! This time India take the review but it seems to be going down the leg side to the naked eye and yes, the Ball Tracker has confirmed it. Impact is way outside leg.
Shannon Gabriel is the last man in for the hosts. The skipper is out of here and India will be looking to wrap this up now as soon as possible.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Excellent delivery from Shami. It is a good length ball outside the off stump line, Holder goes for a drive but gets a thick outside edge back to the keeper. The Windies seriously needed Holder to stay out there in the middle in order to get any closer to India's score. A good partnership of 41 runs comes to an end. The hosts still trail by 77 runs.
Again similar delivery, Cummins is beaten again.
Cummins is beaten at this one. Flatter trajectory and going away from Cummins with the angle, he looks to defend but misses.
Holder takes a single and gives the strike to Cummins to negotiate the last 2 balls of this over. Full and pushed towards mid on as Holder crosses end.
Tossed up on off, pushed towards the off side.
This time slower through the air, again defended by Holder.
Flat outside the off pole, blocked out by Jason.
Bouncer! It is bowled on the leg stump line, Cummins does well to duck under it.

NOT OUT! It is a full delivery outside the off stump line, Cummins goes for a defense but misses. Shami and the keeper goes for an appeal and the umpire gives it out. Cummins goes for the review straight away indicating that it has not hit the bat. The replays roll in, the front foot is fine and Ultra Edge shows that there is a distance between the bat and ball. Cummins survives. He has faced 40 deliveries and is yet to get off the mark.
REVIEW TIME! This time the hosts have taken the review and Cummins looks pretty confident that he hasn't edged it. Replays roll in and nothing on the Ultra Edge. Good review by Cummins.
Good length ball on the off stump line, Holder pushes this to cover-point and takes a single.
Good length ball on middel, Holder defends it off the back foot.
Another full delivery on middle, Holder pushes this to short mid-wicket.
Full delivery on middle, Holder flicks it to mid-wicket.

DRINKS! Holder and Cummins have shown tremendous resistance here. Cummins is yet to get off the mark but has managed to stay in there. Holder has looked good and should look to continue inorder to get closer to India's score.
Loopy delivery on middle, Cummins defends it off the front foot back to the bowler.
Looped up ball on middle, Jason pushes this to mid on and gives Cummins to face the last ball of the over.
Floated delivery on middle, Jason defends it to short leg.
Fullish delivery on middle, Holder flicks it towards square leg and takes a couple to keep the strike.
Loopy delivery on middle, Holder blocks it out.
Flighter delivery on off, Holder pushes this towards cover.
This time Shami attacks the stumps, Cummins blocks it out well off the back foot.
Another length ball outside off, Cummins looks to block this one out but bails out in the end.
Outside off, Cummins lets this one through to Pant. Wasteful ball by Shami.
Some pondering by Holder but he trusts Cummins this time and takes a single. Length ball around off, Jason guides it towards the empty point region and takes a single.
Beaten! Holder living dangerously here. Length ball around off pole, it pitches and moves away. Holder hangs his bat at it but the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
Fuller one around off, pushed towards cover by Holder.

Third play and a miss in a row! Cummins has faced 35 balls in this innings and is yet to get off the mark. It is a flighted delivery on the fourth stump line, Cummins looks to defend but misses the ball again. He has played and missed a lot of ball in this innings so far and should consider himself lucky to not edge any of that.
Another play and a miss! Cummins attempts to defend this flighted delivery outside off but misses the ball completely.
BEATEN! Another one from Cummins. Jadeja comes around the wicket and pushes this ball outside off, Cummins goes for a defense but misses.
Flighted delivery on middle, Cummins defends it back to the bowler.
Looped up ball on middle, Cummins blocks it out.
Flatter delivery outside the off pole line, Cummins leaves it alone.
FOUR! Boundary to end the first over of Shami today. Length ball outside off, Holder pulls this one towards mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length delivery just outside off nipping back in, Holder misses his pull and is hit on the thigh pad.
Fuller this time, pushed towards mid on by Jason.
Again beaten! Outside off, length ball, Holder looks to defend but does so inside the line.

NOT OUT! However, the review has been retained by India. The umpire signaled not out but the ball is clipping the top of middle and leg. This one is pitched on a good length around off, the ball nips back in with the angle and hits Holder on the back pad and carries to Pant after that. Jason is on the front foot and maybe it's his big stature that the umpire takes into account as the Indian players are denied after a loud appeal. After a bit of consideration with Shami, Kohli goes for the review. Ultra Edge comes in and shows no bat involved. Now comes the Ball Tracker, pitched outside off, impact in line, clipping the top of middle and leg. Umpire's call and Holder survives. India though retain the review.
REVIEW TIME! This looks to be hitting middle but Holder is a tall man so you never know. The Indian players think for a while before taking the review.
Full on middle and leg, Holder flicks it to deep fine leg but does not take the single as he wants to keep the strike.
Mohammad Shami comes into the attack.
BEATEN! Another flighted ball outside off, Cummins right now is unable to put bat on it. Miguel goes for a defense again but misses.
Flighted delivery on middle, Cummins finally puts bat on it and defends it to cover.
Flatter delivery ooutside off, Cummins attempts to defend again but is unable to put bat on it.
Another play and a miss! Loopy delivery on off, Cummins goes for another defense and misses the ball.
BEATEN! Flighted delivery outside off, Cummins goes for the defense but misses.
Full delivery on the pads, Holder flicks it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Spin for the first time in the day. Ravindra Jadeja comes into the attack.
Very full delivery outside the off pole line, Cummins this time leaves it alone.
Another play and a miss! It is another full delivery on the fourth stump line. Cummins looks to defend but fails to put bat on it. It is fifth play and a miss in the span of three overs.
BEATEN! Full delivery outside off, Cummins attempts to defend but misses.
BOUNCER! A good one at that. It is aimed at the body and Cummins ducks under it.
Very full delivery outside the off stump line, Cummins leaves it alone.
Good length ball on middle, Cummins defends it off the front foot.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Holder pushes this to the leg side off the back foot.
Good length ball outside off, Holder goes for a defense but gets an outside edge which bounces in front of first slip.
NO BALL! It is a low full toss on off, Holder flicks it but does not time it well. It goes past the mid on fielder and they take a couple.
FOUR! Nicely played from Holder. It is a back of a length delivery on off, Holder rocks back and lofts this over the mid on fielder for a boundary.
Good length ball on middle, Jason plays this towards mid on.
Full delivery on off, Holder pushes it to mid off.
On a good length on middle, Holder blocks it out.

Third play and a miss from Cummins! Excellent over comes to an end from Ishant. It is another full delivery outside off, Cummins attempts to defend but gets beaten again. It misses the bat by a whisker.
Another play and miss! It is a full delivery on the fourth stump line, Cummins again goes for a defense but misses it again.
BEATEN! Good ball from Sharma, bowls this on the fourth stump line, Cummins looks to defend but is unable to put bat on it. Ishant should look to bowl more on this channel.
Bowls a full delivery coming around the wicket outside the off pole line, Cummins is happy to leave it alone.
On a length outside off, Cummins lets it go to the keeper.
Good length ball outside off, Cummins leaves it alone.

FOUR! 200 up for the hosts. This is almost identical to the last boundary. Full and outside off, Jason opens the face of the bat and guides this to the point fence. Cummins now will have to face the first ball of the next over as Holder fails to retain the strike. A very rare expensive over by Bumrah, 9 runs off it.
Wide! Way wide outside the off stump and Holder does not fiddle with it. Wide signaled by the umpire.
FOUR! First boundary of the day for the hosts. Full and around off, Holder just opens the face of the bat and guides it between point and gully towards the third man fence.
Another fuller one outside off, pushed towards the cover fielder again.
Good length ball on off, Holder pushes this to cover.
Fuller on middle and leg, Holder pushes it towards mid on.

Good length ball wide outside off, Holder looks to push it through covers but gets a thick outside edge on it. The ball rolls towards third man. There was a run on offer but Holder will keep as much of the strike as he can and that's why he does not take a run.
On a good length outside off, Cummins leaves it alone.
BOUNCER! It is aimed at the body, Cummins does well to duck under it.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Holder pushes this to cover-point and takes a single.

Good length ball on off, Holder looks to defend but gets an outside edge which bounces just in front of Pant. It is another good delivery from Ishant which induces this edge from Holder who plays this with soft hands. The keeper makes a good diving stop on the bounce behind the stumps.
Good length ball on middle, Holder flicks it to fine leg but refuses to take a single.
BEATEN! Good ball from Ishant. It is a good length ball on the fourth stump line, Holder looks to defend but misses. Lucky not to have edged that ball as it just passed the bat by a whisker.
Good length delivery on off, Cummins defends it off the front foot.
Bumrah loses his line here. It is a full delivery way down the leg side, Miguel looks to flick but misses.
On a length outside off, Holder guides it to third man and takes a single. Cummins has two balls to survive.
Good length delivery on off, Holder drives this towards cover and takes a brace. Mayank Agarwal runs after the ball and cleans it up.
Full delivery on middle, Holder drives this nicely towards mid on. No run.
Good length ball on off, Holder defends it off the front foot.
Jasprit Bumrah will continue the attack from the other end. 15-4-36-1 so far from him.
On a length on off, Cummins blocks it out.
Good length delivery on middle, Cummins defends it back to the bowler.
Another full delivery outside off, Cummins looks to defend but changes his mind and lets it go in the end.
BEATEN! Bowls it full on the fourth stump line, Cummins looks to defend but misses it completely.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Cummins leaves it alone.

The physio is out in the middle right after the first ball of today's play. Cummins is hit on the box and he looks pretty shook up one can say. The good news is Cummins is alright and he is ready to continue the battle.
Starts with a good length delivery on middle, Cummins attempts to defend but misses and gets hit on the box. He looks in serious pain here and is lying down on the ground.

We are all set to begin Day 3. The Indian players are in a huddle and take their respective fielding positions. Jason Holder and Miguel Cummins make their way out to the middle. Ishant Sharma will start the proceedings for the day.

Daren Ganga is there for the pitch report. He says that the cracks have opened up and there is rain predicted in the morning session. He is joined by Sunil Gavaskar and he says the pitch has played well but there are cracks which will worry the batters but it should still be good for batting. He further says that the batsmen should not look to drive uppishly on this wicket.

Murali Karthik is down for an Interview with Ishant Sharma. He says that he will look to continue bowling well. He further states that he was not expecting that Windies will come out all guns blazing and after discussions with the skipper, he changed his length to a back of a length delivery where it is difficult to hit the ball. On the commentators suggesting to bowl over the wicket, Ishant says that he is not sure and it depends on the conditions.  Says that he started bowling more fuller deliveries over the last two years which  helped him get more wickets in England and Australia. Sharma states that County cricket has helped him over the last few years.

The wicket of the Windies skipper holds the key for both the sides today because if India get him out early on, the hosts would be in big trouble and the Calypso Kings would want their skipper to take them as close to the visitors total as he can. An enthralling and match-deciding first session awaits us and both the sides will be geared up for it.

Welcome to Day 3 of the first Test match between the West Indies and India. Day 2 ended with the hosts 8 down with just 189 runs on the board. They trail the visitors by 108 runs with skipper Jason Holder and Miguel Cummins on the pitch.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

Earlier in the day, Jadeja's half ton took India to a above par score. That knock could well prove to be the difference in the end. However, if Holder can do something similar, then we can be in for an exciting day of cricket on Saturday. Do join us at 0930 local (1330 GMT). Until then, its goodbye!

India did not start as well as they would have hoped with the ball but got their lines and lengths right soon after and kept picking wickets at regular intervals. Ishant Sharma was the star as he picked up his 9th five-wicket haul in Tests. Other bowlers supported him well and all except for Vihari, chipped in with a wicket at least.

The hosts started well with the bat but ended up being three down at Tea. After the break, Chase and Hope stitched a good 42-run stand before Chase threw his wicket just before his half century. Hetmyer and Hope continued the good work before a short rain break halted the momentum. The break proved to be a bad one for the Windies as they slipped from 174-5 to 179-8. Now Windies' hopes lie on skipper Holder to get them as close as possible towards India's score.

That is Stumps on Day 2! It has been an absorbing day of Test match cricket with India in a commanding position by the end of it all. West Indies end the Day 108 runs behind the visitors with Holder being the only recognized batsman at the crease.
Slower one this time but closer to off pole, blocked nicely by Holder. And, that's STUMPS on Day 2.
Good length around off again, blocked towards gully by Holder with a solid push.
Fullish around off, Holder lunges forward to block it back to the bowler.
Goes for a slower on this time but it is again wide on the off side, leaves it alone.
Good length outside off, Holder covers his off pole and lets it go to Pant.
Good length ball on middle, rises slightly on the hips, Holder works it fine down the leg side but denies a run.
Jasprit Bumrah comes back into the attack.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Another leading edge as Holder looks to flick this fullish ball towards the leg side. The ball goes to the cover fielder and Holder takes a run. He is farming the strike here.
Wide outside off this time, left alone.

In the air but safe! Good length ball on middle this time, Holder looks to heave this towards mid wicket but the ball takes the leading edge and lobs high in the air. Vihari runs from third man and makes a diving effort but can't reach the ball. Ishant Sharma is not a happy man because of that effort there.
Fuller this time as Holder flicks it nicely towards square leg. He denies the single there.
Goes past the outside edge of the opposition skipper with a beauty. Pitched on a good length closer to the off pole. Holder has a poke at it but misses to put bat on ball.
Shortish length on the hips, worked down the leg side for nothing.
Fullish ball on the pads, Holder flicks it nicely through mid-wicket. They take three before the ball is back to the keeper.
FOUR! Fuller length outside off from Shami. Holder opens the face of the bat and guides this through the vacant third man region to get off the mark with a boundary.
Fuller again outside off, Holder times it straight to mid off.
Full ball outside off, pushed back to the bowler by Holder.
Good length ball on off, blocked by Holder.
Miguel Cummins is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fifer for Ishant as Kohli gobbles this catch in the second slip. West Indies in all sorts of trouble now. Fullish ball around the fifth stump, Roach looks to drive this one but the ball takes an outside edge and goes straight to Kohli at second slip. The skipper is not going to miss out on that one. He takes it comfortably and celebrates with his bowler. 9th fifer for Ishant and this one has left Windies reeling. The hosts are still trailing by 118 runs.
Good length ball on stumps this time, blocked again.
Good length ball outside off, Roach blocks it off his back foot.
Kemar Roach joins his skipper out in the middle.

OUT! Superb catch of his own bowling by Ishant. They again check for the front foot no ball but this is safe. Good length ball on middle and leg, Hetmyer looks to push with hard hands towards mid on but because of the closed bat face, the ball lobs towards Ishant. He does really well to get down and grab that one nicely. Number four for Ishant as he removes another set Windies batsman. It is just his third caught and bowled in 91 Test matches. Can he take a fifer here?
Good length ball outside off, Hetmyer looks to guide it again in the same direction but he is beaten this time.
FOUR! Shortish length outside off from Ishant, Hetmyer guides it nicely through the gully region for a boundary.
Slightly shorter in length, closer to the fifth stump line. Holder lets it go to the keeper again.
Wide outside off this time, Holder leaves it alone.
Fullish ball on middle and off, Holder pushes this straight to mid on.
Good length ball which is coming into the batter, Holder covers his off stump and lets it go to the keeper.
Slightly fuller this time around off, guided through the gully region for a single.
Good length ball on the body, worked towards mid on for nothing.
Jason Holder is the new man in. A lot depends on him if the Windies hope to reach closer to the Indians score.

OUT! Caught by Pant coming forward. Yes, a clean catch that one. Fullish length ball outside off, shapes a tad bit away as Hope has a poke. Gets an outside edge and the ball goes to the keeper. It dips as it goes to Pant who comes forward to pouch this one comfortably. Some doubts there regarding the catch but Hope has to walk back as it looks a clean catch and the same has been confirmed by the third umpire. Another timely wicket for India and another Windies batter walks back after getting a decent start.Ishant gets his third. West Indies still behind by 123 runs.
Third Umpire has been called into question for a caught behind. The soft signal is out from the umpires.
Wide outside off this time, Hope lets it be.
Goes round the wicket and looks to bowl a shortish one on the body. It goes down the leg side with the angle but Hetmyer manages to pull nicely to pick up a single.
Shortish one this time, closer to the body again but Hetmyer is right behind the line to block it well again.
Some Sawdust has been brought on to cover the run up area as the bowlers might be slipping.
Good length ball closer to the off stump, Hetmyer lunges forward to block.
Good length ball down the leg side, Hetmyer looks to flick but misses.
Ishant Sharma comes back into the attack.
This time he defends it solidly.
This time outside off, Hope comes forward to dab it towards the leg side but dabs it off the inside edge closer to the short leg fielder.
Loopy fullish one this time, pushed back to Jadeja
Full ball down the leg side, flicked down the fine leg by Hetmyer to take a run.
Another fullish ball, pushed towards mid on, Jadeja looks to stop but misses. They take a run.
Fuller one, pushed back to the bowler.
Shortish ball on middle, pulled through square leg for a run.
Outside off, comes across to block this one.
Wide outside off, asking for a drive but left alone.

Nearly a wicket for Vihari! Quicker ball to which Hetmyer looks to push but gets an inside edge which sneaks between bat and pad. Ishant chases it down to the third man to save a boundary. Three taken there.
Shortish one outside off, Hope cuts it through point to pick up a single.
Loopy one Outside off, left alone.
Another full ball tapped right of the bowler. They take a single.
Too straight and flighted one, pushed confidently towards mid on. Hetmyer takes a run.
Fullish one which is pushed back to the bowler.
Flighted ball on middle, worked towards mid off and take a quick run.
Loopy ball outside off, worked towards cover to change ends.
Fullish one on middle, tucked straight to mid-wicket.
Shortish ball outside off, Hope wanted to heave this down the leg side but pushed awkwardly straight to mid off.
Loopy ball on off and middle, worked straight to mid on.
The sun is shining now and we are all set to resume. The Indian players go back to their fielding positions after being in a huddle. Out come the Windies batsmen, Hope and Hetmyer.
1648 local (2048 GMT) - Looks like it was just a passing shower as the covers have been taken off with the umpires doing an inspection in the middle. Play should resume soon.
It has started to rain heavily now and the umpires are calling for the covers and this might be Stumps as it is the same time as yesterday when the rains had resulted in Stumps.
Loopy ball around off, turns away from the right-hander who looks to play at it but decided against it at the last moment.
Full toss on off, Hetmyer pushes this through mid off to take a run.
What a stop that from Jadeja! Short ball outside off, Hetmyer crunches this towards point but can't get past Jadeja. He has been a live wire on the ground.
Starts with a loopy shortish one, Hope pushes it past the bowler who dives to his right to stop but fails to do so. They take a run as the ball goes towards mid on.
Hanuma Vihari comes into the attack. As we speak, it has started to drizzle a little bit and the groundsman are getting ready near the boundary.
Flighted delivery on middle, Hope flicks it to fine leg and takes a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, Hope plays it to cover.
Shorter delivery on middle, Shimron flicks it towards square leg and takes a single.
Looped up ball on middle, Hetmyer blocks it out.
FOUR! Flighted delivery on off, Hetmyer comes down the track and lofts this over between the mid off and cover fielder for a boundary.
Loopy delivery on off, Hetmyer defends it off the front foot.
Wide outside off, left alone this time.
Wow! Another solid timing from Hope. A straight one on a fullish length from Bumrah. Hope gets in the perfect position again and pushes this past the bowler sweetly to pick up another brace.
Goes for a yorker this time. Hetmyer gets his bat in time to block. The ball rolls towards mid-wicket and the batters take one.

Timing on that one was superb! Fullish ball outside off, Hope gets into position and plays a perfect cover drive. The ball was racing towards the fence but Agarwal chases  it and save a run as the batters take three.
Shorter around off this time, Hope guides it through gully and takes a couple. Ishant chases the ball and sends it back to the keeper.
Length ball on the pads, worked towards the leg side to take a run.
Hope Blocks this by getting right behind of the line of the delivery.
Fuller one again. Hetmyer Looks to go over the mid on fielder but gets it off his bottom half of the bat towards long on. A run taken.
Fuller and flighted, Shimron pushes this back to the bowler this time.
Good length on off, blocked off his front foot.
Loopy down the leg side, Hetmyer works it fine down the leg side to take a couple. The fielder was slow there allowing the second.
Start with a loopy fuller ball, defended towards cover.
Ravindra Jadeja is back for another spell.
Short ball on the body, pulls it towards square leg to take a run.
Fuller one this time, Hetmyer pushes it towards cover. This was in the air again but just short. Living dangerously is Hetmyer.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Another outside edge but this one looked deliberate. Good length ball outside off, Hetmyer dabs it towards the third slip fielder. The ball falls just short of him and he fails to collect and the ball goes for a boundary.
Edge but short! Fullish length ball on off, Hetmyer looks to drive this one but gets an outside edge but the ball goes off the outside edge towards KL Rahul at second slip.
Starts with a fuller one on middle, Hetmyer blocks it by coming forward.
Jasprit Bumrah is on after the break.
Fuller on the pads, Hetmyer works it nicely towards mid-wicket to get a single. They wanted a couple there but Jadeja was quick to the ball and they decided against the second run.

DRINKS! West Indies are in a serious need of a partnership here as Holder is the the only recognized batsman after this pair. Indian bowlers will look to make further inroads before end of play today.
Goes past the outside edge this time! Superb ball around the fifth stump line on a good length. Hetmyer has a poke but the ball goes past his hanging bat straight to the keeper.
Another good length ball coming into the the batter, Hetmyer lunges to block.
Good length ball on off and middle, blocked nicely with soft hands.
Bowls a full length down the leg side, Shimron attempts to flick but misses it completely.
On a good length on off, Hetmyer pushes it to point.
Shortish ball around off, Hetmyer looks to work it towards gully but is early into his shot. The ball takes a leading edge and goes towards cover. Hetmyer gets a run.
Back of a length ball on off, Hetmyer gets behind the ball to block it on the off side.
Back of a length on the body of Hetmyer who swivels and pulls this towards square leg. Jadeja hares at the ball and flicks it back before it touches the rope. Saved two there
Good length ball around off, pushed towards the off side off his back foot.
Beaten! Shortish length which comes back in. Hetmyer looks to punch this off his back foot but is beaten. Lucky not to edge.
Fullish ball around the fourth stump line, Hetmyer comes forward and times it through covers to take a couple.
Good length ball outside off, left alone by Hope.
Slightly fullish one and closer to the off pole, Hope lunges forward to block.
Good length ball on the stumps, Hope does well to block.
Bumper on the body to welcome the new man, Hetmyer, who hops in his crease to work it towards square leg to get off the mark.
Shimron Hetmyer is the new man in for the hosts.

OUT! Caught! Sharp catch that by KL Rahul! Chase departs just two short of his half century. Oh wait! The umpires are checking for the no ball there. That looks very close. Well, legal one confirms the umpire and Chase takes the long walk back to the pavilion. This is a good length ball on middle, Chase flicks it off his back foot but KL Rahul at square leg takes a sharp catch. End of a 42-run stand. Timely wicket for India this one.
Starts his new spell with a good length ball outside off, blocked nicely by Chase.
Ishant Sharma comes back into the attack.
length ball on middle, Chase looks to cut but gets an inside edge and the ball goes fine down the leg side. Single taken.
Fullish one this time, pushed firmly towards the bowler.

That sneaked in! Beautiful ball from Shami. Good line and length from Shami, the ball comes in from a good length ball to cut the batsman into half. The ball goes between bat and pad to Pant who can't gather it cleanly as it came to him on the bounce. Looked in pain but is ready to go.
Blocked this good length ball by getting right behind the delivery.

FOUR! Nicely timed! Wide outside off from Shami on a fullish length. Hope times it superbly through covers. Jadeja gives it a chase but the ball wins the race. If Jadeja can't get to the ball, one should know that the timing is superb on that one.
Starts with a shortish one on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Fullish one pushed towards the cover fielder.
Flatter and quicker this time, blocked off his front foot.
Shorter one this time. Hope goes back to cut it through gully and point. Takes another couple of runs.
Played off his front foot to this loopy ball around off.
Fuller one to Chase who works it towards mid off to take a run.

Poor effort from the deep cover fielder there. Loopy ball outside off, Chase pushes this through point. The fielder in the deep is lazy to go down quickly which allows Hope to return for the second run.
Good ball to end the over. Lets this one to come into the body of Hope who blocks it well towards leg side.
FOUR! Creamed through the covers. Full ball from Shami to which Hope leans forward and drives it beautifully through mid off. The fielder there gives it a chase but no chance for him.
Shorter ball this time. Hope ducks under and lets the keeper collect that one.
Shortish one outside off, Chase punched it off his back foot through point to take a single.
Good line and length there from Shami. Chase covered his stumps and allowed this one to go the keeper.
Good length ball outside off, Chase leaves it alone.
Shortish one outside off, Chase works it through covers to take a single.
Fuller down the leg side, worked fine by Hope for a single.
Fuller one from Jadeja, Hope pushes this to mid off.
On the middle stump this time, blocked well.
Worked on the off side off his back foot, takes a single.
FOUR! Lucky there maybe. Shortish ball on off and middle, Chase goes back and pulls it nicely for a boundary. It was not too far away from the mid-wicket fielder.
Bumper around off to finish the over. Chase ducks under it.
Fuller one around off, blocked nicely again.
Back of a length outside off, Chase dabs it towards cover to change ends.
Good length ball on the stumps, blocked nicely again by Chase.
Good length ball around off, Chase pushes this off his back foot towards short cover.
Starts with a fullish one on off, Chase pushes it back to the bowler.
Mohammad Shami is back into the attack.
Gets forward to this one to block it well. Tidy over from Jadeja.
Loopy and fuller, worked towards mid off.
Fullish on off, pushed straight to cover.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
OHH! Flighted and quicker on off and middle, Hope is beaten and the ball goes between bat and pad. Just a bit high or else it would've hit the stumps. Pant fails to collect that one cleanly.
Shortish outside off, cut away through point and cover to take a single.
Fuller one this time, aiming the timbers. Hope gets his bat down in time to block this one out.
Bumper outside off, Hope does well to sway away from it.
Slightly shortish in length again, Chase works it nicely towards mid on to get off strike.
Shorter one on the body of Hope who works it off his back foot towards square leg to get a run.
Outswinger outside off, Hope looks to fend at it but the away movement meant that he couldn't get any willow on that one.
Good length ball around the off stump channel, blocked well.
Fuller one down the leg side, Chase looks to work it down the leg side but gets hit on the pad.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Sharp turn on that one. Shortish length on off and middle, Chase looks to cut but is beaten.
Blocks well to this loopy one by coming forward.
Loopy ball outside off, Chase looks to push this towards the off side but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
The physio is out there to have a look at Mayank Agarwal who has got hit near his neck. The ball was flicked hard by Chase towards him. He seems to be fine and will continue.
OUCH! That would've hurt. Loopy ball on shortish length, Hope looks to flick this off his back foot but hits the short leg fielder closer to the neck. Agarwal looks in pain.

Nice shot! Shortish ball outside off this time from Bumrah. Chase works it nicely through the point and gully region. Jadeja chases the ball and stops it before it touches the fence. Three runs taken.
Another bumper! But this is too high for Chase to do anything on that. Ducks under it.
Good length ball coming into the batter, blocked off his back foot.
Bouncer on middle, Chase ducks under it.

FOUR! Shortish one outside off, chance to throw the bat at it for Chase who looks to cut but the ball flies off his outside edge over the slip and gully region. Lucky boundary that one. 100 up for Windies with that boundary.
Good length ball on off and middle, Chase blocks it towards mid on off his back foot.
Pushed straight to cover this time.
Ohh! Flighted delivery on middle this time but Hope looks to block off his front foot, the ball turns a bit and gets an inside edge onto the pads. Lucky that he got an edge there.
Fuller one again, slapped straight to short cover.
Flatter one short of a length, blocked off his back foot.
Fullish this time, Chase drives it through mid off to get off strike.
Loopy one on middle, worked straight to point.
Wide outside off again, left alone.
Good length ball coming in to the body of Hope who blocks this off his back foot.
Wide outside off this time, left alone.
Fuller ball outside off this time, Hope leans into the drive and times the ball sweetly through the point region. Jadeja chases the ball and cuts it off. A couple taken.
Bouncer down the leg side, ducked by Shai.
Shortish outside off, left alone by Hope.
Full delivery on middle, Chase blocks it out off the front foot.
Flighted delivery on middle, Chase defends it back to the bowler.
Looped up ball on off, Chase defends this to the off side.
Flighted delivery on middle, Chase blocks it out.
SIX! Nice shot from Chase. It is a full delivery on middle, Chase plays a lofted drive  over the  long on fence for a maximum. Chase is batting with a lot of confidence here.
Loopy delivery on middle, Chase plays it back to the bowler.
Another good length ball outside off, blocked by Hope off his back foot.
Good length ball outside off, blocked nicely by Hope.
Wide outside off this time, left alone by Hope.
Good length ball around off, blocked by Shai.
Good length ball outside off first up to Hope, he shoulders arms to this one.
Shai Hope is the new man in.

OUT LBW! Bumrah strikes first ball of his over after Tea. Or has he? Bravo has decided to take the LBW decision upstairs. Good length ball on around off, Bravo looks to flick but he misses and is hit on the pads. Bumrah and the Indian team make an appeal and the umpire raises his finger after taking his time. Replays roll in with Ultra Edge confirming no bat involved. And then, Ball Tracker comes in and it confirms the decision of the umpire that the ball was shattering into the middle and leg stump. Great decision by the umpire there. The Windies have lost their first review. Number 50 for Bumrah in Test match cricket.
REVIEW TIME! Bravo has been given out LBW and he has opted to review. It looked out in real time and let's see what happens.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl from the other end.
Fullish ball outside off this time, Chase creams this through the cover region this time get a boundary this time.
Loopy ball on middle and off, bloked by Chase coming forward.
Short ball outside off, Chase goes back to push it though covers to pick a couple.
Blocked off the back foot this time.
Fullish one this time, worked towards mid on.
Loopy delivery on off, looked to block but goes from inner off his bat towards mid on.

We are back for the final session of the day and it should be an interesting one.  Roston Chase and  Darren Bravo make their way into the middle along with the Indian players. Jadeja to start the proceedings for India.
...Day 2, Session 3...

When we return for the final session, the hosts would look to get to stumps without further hiccups while the visitors would want to get into the tail of the opposition's batting line up by picking quick wickets. Join us back in a while.

Ishant removed the other opener, Kraigg Brathwaite to pull things in India's court. And then, Jadeja got rid of debutant Shamarh Brooks to leave the Windies in trouble. However, Bravo arrived and scored quick runs to keep the scoreboard ticking. Chase along with him made sure India doesn't get another wicket.

After Lunch, West Indies started briskly with Campbell going after the bowling and scoring quick runs against the pacers. However, Shami dismissed Campbell in his first over to peg the Windies' run flow. He along with Bumrah didn't offer any freebies after the first wicket.
Good length ball on off, Chase plays it towards point and takes a single. With that it is TEA ON DAY 2.
Full delivery on the off pole line, Chase pushes it towards mid on.
Bowls this full delivery down the leg side, Roston attempts to flick but misses.
Full delivery on middle, Chase pushes this back to the bowler.
On a length outside the off pole line, Chase shoulders arms to this one.
Good length ball on the pads, Bravo flicks it towards square leg and takes a single. Jadeja has a shy at the keepers end but misses. It would not have mattered as the batsman was well in.
Ishant is back on as well from the other end.
BOUNCER! It is bowled above the batsman's head who is happy to let it go.
Short ball aimed at the body, Chase uncomfortably fends at it and gets an inside edge into the ground.
Good length delivery on off, Bravo defends this to point and takes a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Chase cuts towards point and takes a single.
OHH! Bumrah bowls an excellent yorker on middle, Chase does well to block it out.
Good length ball outside the off stump line, Roston leaves it alone.
Bumrah back on for a burst before Tea.
Bravo leaves this good length ball back to the bowler.
Good length ball outside off, Bravo defends it to point.
Good length delivery on off, Bravo gets an outside edge while trying to defend it.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Chase punches this off the back foot past the cover and point fielders and take a couple.
On a length on off, Chase defends it off the front foot to cover.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Chase defends it off the back foot.
Fuller one on middle, worked towards mid on to take a quick single as the fielder makes a half0stop.
Fullish length to which Bravo comes forward and pushes towards mid-wicket to take a run.
SIX! Shot! Loopy one on the middle this time and Bravo reads it well and slams this with the spin over the mid-wicket fence. Terrific timing on that one from Bravo.
FOUR! Shortish length ball on the fourth stump line. Bravo looked to slash it hard through point but the ball flies off the outside edge past Rahane in the first slip.
Loopy one on middle, blocked well.
Flighted one on middle, Bravo tucks it towards mid on.
Good length ball on off, Chase defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Good shot from Chase. It is a full delivery outside off, Chase prods forward and drives it past the mid off fielder for his first boundary and along with that gets off the mark.
Good length ball on middle, Chase plays it back to the bowler.
Good length ball on off, Chase this time defends it off the front foot towards the off side.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Chase defends it off the back foot.
BOUNCER! Very high this time from Shami. Chase ducks under it and Pant jumps to make an excellent stop over his head behind the stumps.
Shorter delivery outside off, Bravo leaves it alone.
Flighted delivery on off, Bravo defends this off the back foot.
Full delivery on middle, Bravo plays this towards square leg.
Shorter delivery on off, Bravo pushes it to cover.
Flighted delivery on middle, Bravo blocks it out.
Full delivery on off, Bravo pushes this to cover.
Good length ball on middle, Chase blocks it back to the bowler.
Good length ball on middle, Chase defends it off the back foot to mid-wicket.
OUCH! Good length delivery on middle, Chase looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the box. The ball nipped back in after pitching.
Good length delivery on the pads, Bravo flicks this towards the fine leg fielder and takes a single.
FOUR! Bravo is off the mark. It is a good length delivery on off, Bravo leans into the drive and hits it past the mid on fielder for a boundary. His first boundary of the game.
BEATEN! On a good length outside off, Bravo attempts to defend but misses.
Shami is back on!
Drives this fullish ball but finds the silly point fielder.
Fullish ball pushed towards mid off.

4 Byes! How did that not shatter the stumps! What a ripper from Jadeja. Arm ball on the middle and off. Chase lunges forward to block but gets beaten. Also, Pant is beaten as well and the ball goes just above the stumps. Lucky there, Roston Chase.
Roston Chase is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Debutant is outta here. Three down West Indies! Shortish ball on middle, Brooks went back to cut this through point but he gets an outside edge which hits Pant on the pads and lobs straight to Rahane. Might consider himself unlucky there. The top three are in the hut for Windies.
Full delivery on middle, Brooks pushes it back to the bowler.
Loopy ball on the middle stump line, tucked straight to mid-wicket.
Wide outside off from Ishant to finish the over. Bravo lets it be.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Bravo blocks it awkwardly as the ball shoots off the surface.
Good length ball on the fifth stump line, Bravo looked to drive initially but pulled back from the shot as it came close to him.
Good length outside off, left alone.
Bumper this time, Bravo ducks under it.
Shortish length on middle to start, Bravo blocks off his back foot.
Fullish one on middle, pushed to mid off.
Blocked this loopy ball on middle by coming forward.
Short one this time, Brooks goes back and drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Fuller one which is pushed back to the bowler.
Short outside off this time, Brooks goes back and cuts it through cover and point to pick up a couple. 50 up for West Indies with that couple.
Fuller on off, Brooks finds the cover fielder.
Beaten! Goes through the outside edge of the new man this time. Shortish ball on off, Bravo looks to fend at it off his toes but is beaten. Wicket maiden from Ishant.
Darren Bravo is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! This time Brathwaite lobs it back to the bowler. His vigil ends. Fuller ball on the fourth stump line for Kraigg who looks to drive this through mid off but he has his bat face closed as he drives. The ball lobs towards Sharma who takes an excellent catch off his own bowling.
Another good defense from Kraigg to this good length ball outside off. Comes forward and blunts it on the off side.
Good length on the fourth stump line, blocked well by Brathwaite.
Fullish ball on off, KB looks to push this towards mid off but plays it uppishly towards the bowler as he gets it off his inner half of the bat. Lands well short of Sharma.
Good length ball outside off, going further away. Brathwaite lets it be.
Fuller one on off, blocked off the front foot. Tight start from Jadeja.
BEATEN! Looped up ball outside off, Brooks attempts to defend but fails to put bat on it.
Flighted delivery on middle, Brooks defends it off the front foot.
Flatter delivery on middle, Brooks flicks it to fine leg and takes a couple.
Loopy delivery on middle, Brooks defends it to cover.
Loopy delivery on the pads, Brathwiate flicks this to fine leg and takes a single.
Spin time! Ravindra Jadeja is into the attack.

FOUR! Pitched up ball from Ishant on the pads, Brooks flicks it nicely through square leg and the ball races to the fence. This is Shamarh Brook's first boundary in International cricket and it is a good shot from him.
BEATEN! Good ball from Ishant. It is a full delivery on the fourth stump line, Brooks attempts to defend but gets beaten due to the outswing on it.
Back of a length outside off, Brooks leaves it alone.
Good length ball on middle, Brooks defends this off the back foot to the leg side.
Good length ball on middle, Shamarh blocks it out.
On a good length outside the off stump, Brooks leaves it alone.
Change of ends for Ishant Sharma. 4-0-26-0 so far.
On a good length outside the off pole line, Brathwaite leaves it alone.
Good length ball outside the off stump line, Kraigg defends it off the front foot.
BOUNCER! Bowls this one way above the batsman's head. Brathwaite ducks under it.
Good length ball on middle, Brooks flicks this nicely towards the mid-wicket region and takes three. Shamarh gets off the mark in International cricket after 15 balls.
Good length ball on off, Brooks defends it towards the off side.
BOUNCER! Excellent one. It is bowled at the body, Brooks does extremely well to duck under it.

Drinks! West Indies have done well here in the first hour against this sharp Indian attack. They started well with Campbell attacking from the word go.  Shami came in to remove him in his first over to stop the run flow. Brathwaite and Brooks have not allowed another wicket but the runs are not coming the way they did at the start. Interesting to see how things pan out in the next hour.
On a good length on off, Kraigg flicks it to square leg. Maiden over.
Good length ball on middle, Brathwaite flicks this towards square leg. No run.
On a length on off, Brathwaite defends it towards the leg side.
Full delivery this time, KB drives this towards mid on.
Good length delivery on middle, Brathwaite defends it off the front foot.
Back of a length delivery on off, Kraigg guides it to gully.
IN THE AIR BUT SAFE! A good short one from Bumrah. It is bowled on the body, Brooks looks to flick but gets hit on the gloves and the ball just misses the short leg fielder.
NO BALL! Bumrah oversteps here. It is a back of a length delivery, Shamarh defends it off the back foot.
Goes for a yorker this time, Brooks gets his bat down in time and plays it towards square leg.
Brooks shoulders arms to this good length ball outside the off stump.
Good length delivery on middle, Brooks defends this nicely to cover.
On a length outside the off stump line, Brooks shoulders arms to this one.
Back of a length delivery on off, Brooks defends it off the back foot to the leg side.
Good length ball on middle, Brathwaite defends it to square leg.
Full delivery on off, Kraigg drives this straight to mid off.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Brathwaite flicks it to square leg.
Good length delivery on middle, Kraigg defends it out.
On a length on middle, Brathwiate blocks it out off the back foot.
Full delivery on middle, Brathwaite drives this to mid on.
ANOTHER BOUNCER! This one as well goes over the head of Brooks. Shamarh leaves it alone.
BOUNCER! It is bowled way over the head of Brooks. Shamarh does not feel the need to play at it and ducks under it.
Good length ball on off, Brooks blocks it out.
Short ball outside the off stump line, Brooks looks to defend but decides to leave it alone in the end.
Good length delivery on off, Brooks defends it to the off side.
Full delivery on the middle stump line, Brooks facing his first delivery in International cricket plays this towards mid on.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Brathwaite blocks this one towards the leg side.
Good length delivery on middle, Kraigg defends it back to the bowler.
Good length ball on off, KB defends it to the off side.
Back of a length delivery on off, Kraigg blocks it off the back foot.
On a length outside the off stump line, Brathwaite leaves it alone.
Good length ball on off, Brathwite defends this off the back foot.
Good length ball on off, Brathwaite drives this to cover and takes a single.
BOUNCER! A good one at that. It is bowled on the body, Brathwaite does well to duck under it.
Good length ball on middle, Brathwaite flicks it to mid-wicket.
Good length on off, blocked well by the batsman.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Just short of the gully fielder there. Superb delivery outside off, Brathwaite fends at it and the ball goes off the outside edge towards the gully fielder but just short of him.
Debutant Shamarh Brooks is the new man in.

OUT! Knocked him over! Shami has a wicket in his first over. Bowled a fuller ball on the fourth stump line to the left-hander. Campbell comes forward to jam the ball but drags it back to the stumps. Campbell was going all guns blazing but this was one shot too many for him.
Fullish one again but on the pads. Campbell looks to flick but misses. Pant does well to stop down the leg side.
Fuller one on the pads, KB tucks it towards min on to take a run.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Beaten outside off this time! Good length ball on off, Brathwaite pokes at it but lucky to not edge.
FOUR! Welcome to the attack, Mr. Shami, says Kraigg. Fullish ball outside off, Brathwaite leans into the drive and times it sweetly through covers to get a boundary.
Shami is on now.
Shortish ball outside off, Campbell leaves it alone.

Short ball on middle, Campbell pulls hard but finds the square leg fielder and takes a single. Jadeja hits the stumps and the ball goes towards cover. The batsmen think of taking an overthrow but decide against it but then the cover fielder throws the ball at the bowler's end thinking of running the batter out but misses. And there's no one to backup the underarm throw and they eventually get the second run. Sloppy stuff this from India.
Good length ball on off, John wanted to leave it at first but changes his at the last moment to defend it.
On a good length outside the off stump line, John lets it be.
IN THE AIR BUT SAFE! Sharma bowls a full delivery outside off, John goes for a drive but does not time it well. However he gets enough to go over the point fielder. The batters take a couple.
Good length delivery on off, John defends it off the back foot towards cover and takes a single.
On a length outside off, Campbell leaves it alone.
Loses his line does Bumrah here, bowls a good length delivery down the leg side, John looks to flick but misses.
Good length ball outside the off pole line, Campbell lets it go.
Bowls a full delivery on the pads, Campbell goes for the flick but gets hit on the pads. There is a muffled appeal for LBW but nothing from the umpire.
Full delivery on middle, Campbell pushes this to mid on.
Good length ball on middle, John defends it off the back foot.
On a length outside the off stump line, Kraigg leaves it alone.
Inswinger which is bowled down the leg side, Brathwaite looks to flick but misses.
Short ball on the body, Campbell pulls this nicely towards square leg and takes a single.
Good length delivery on off, Campbell defends it to point.
On a length outside the off stump line, John leaves it alone.
Full delivery on middle, KB flicks it to fine leg and takes a single.
BOUNCER! It is bowled way down the leg side, Campbell does not feel the need to play at it and ducks under it.
On a good length on the pads, Campbell looks to flick but gets hit on the pads.

Full delivery on the pads, Brathwaite flicks this nicely towards the square leg region. Ishant Sharma hares at the ball to stop the ball very close to the rope. Good effort that from the Indian pacer. The umpire wants to check if Ishant was touching the rope when he pulled the ball back. Looks a clean stop. Three runs taken.
Good length delivery on the fourth stump line, KB defends it to the off side.
Good length delivery on the off stump line, Brathwaite defends it off the front foot.
Fullish length outside off, left alone by the batsman.
On a good length ball on off, Campbell defends it off the front foot.

FOUR! Excellent batting from Campbell this. Ishant bowls a full delivery outside the off stump, John prods forward and lofts this over the cover fielder for another boundary. Aggressive cricket this from Campbell.
FOUR! It is not a bad ball from Ishant as he bowls this on a length on off, Campbell pushes it through the gully region for a boundary. Campbell is in some mood here.
Inswinger on the pads, Brathwaite flicks this towards fine leg and takes a single.
BEATEN! Good ball from Sharma. It is a good length delivery outside the off stump line swinging away from the batsman. Brathwaite looks to drive but misses.
Good length delivery on middle, KB flicks it but the fielder at short leg makes a good stop.
Shortish one outside off, Campbell taps it towards point.
Good length ball outside off this time, the batter lets it be.
Back of length on middle which comes in to the left-hander. Campbell looks push this off his back foot towards the leg side but gets hit high on the pads.
Good length on middle and leg, the ball seams away. Campbell looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Stifled appeal from the bowler but no excitement. It was going down.
Bowls this one on a fuller length but too straight as Brathwaite flicks it towards square leg to get off the mark.
Starts with one on a good length outside off, Brathwaite covers his stumps and leaves it alone.
Jasprit Bumrah to share the attack with Ishant Sharma from the other end.
On a good length ball on off, Campbell looks to defend but gets hit high on the pads.

FOUR! Positive start from Campbell. It is a good length ball outside off, John throws his hands at it and drives this towards the point region for his second boundary. The fielder at point dives to take the catch but does not get a hand on it.
Bowls it too straight again does Sharma, John flicks it towards mid-wicket and take a brace.
FOUR! Good shot. It is a full delivery on the pads from Sharma. Campbell flicks it towards the square leg region for the first boundary of the innings. This will give a lot of confidence to John.
On a good length on middle, Campbell defends it back to the bowler.
LEG BYE! Starts with an inswinger on middle, Brathwaite looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls to fine leg and a leg bye is taken
